interpretation_limits: The 4096 node and 32768 tetrahedron constants are current admission/scratch scope limits; this audit does not establish a corresponding Metal uint or shared-memory necessity.
The explicit C=131072 mode is a bounded fail-closed experiment only. It is valid only if actual candidate count is <=C; overflow causes transaction failure, not successful shipping admission.
Stable incidence sorting reduces the legacy O(N*C*6) count/scatter work but does not remove N/T/C or true-residual gates.
Component byte arithmetic omits solver/preconditioner and other runtime arenas and allocator behavior; it is not a 16 GiB peak proof.
